answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 56243 Country: India Title: Halal Haram Question: I am teacher of intermediate college. I have to do duty on the UP Board Examination to evaluate the copy. There are rupees kept in some copies. I want to know how we use this money. Answer ID: 56243 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1/9/N=01/1436) The said money is haram for the examiner. The money is kept with the intention of bribe in order to avail high marks against his/her merit. According to Islam it is haram to take and give bribe. It is mentioned in the Hadith: لعن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الراشي والمرتشي (مشكوة شريف ص 326 بحواله سنن ابوداؤد وغيره) It is necessary to return the money to its owner. If it is not possible then it should be given to a poor. It should not be used in one’s personal use. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
